summary: Comprehensive testing of CAPEX Portal iteration 25 changes: Cosmos theme login page, Admin Themes tab, Sidebar navigation (no Users for non-admin), and Sample action buttons. Fixed bug where sample action buttons weren't showing for 'Pending' status samples.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features tested and working. Login page has cosmos theme with nebula clouds, twinkling stars, shooting stars, and galaxy swirl effect. NO demo credentials, NO bearing/precision/industrial text, NO AES/JWT/RBAC badges. Admin Dashboard has Themes tab with 14 theme options. Sidebar navigation correctly hides Users tab for buyer/capex_head/dept_head roles. Sample action buttons (Under Preparation, Ready for Dispatch) now appear for samples with 'Pending', 'Sample Requested', or 'Under Preparation' status for user/dept_head/process_engineering roles.
